path='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-87fa6952.py'; code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Mirror the colored pattern horizontally into the rectangular zero region.
    coords = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in coords), max(r for r, c in coords)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in coords), max(c for r, c in coords)
    H, W = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    bg = grid[0][0]
    pattern = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg and v != 0]
    pr0, pr1 = min(r for r,c in pattern), max(r for r,c in pattern)
    pc0, pc1 = min(c for r,c in pattern), max(c for r,c in pattern)
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            out[r0+i][c0+j] = grid[pr0+i][pc1-j]
    return out
'''; open(path,'w').write(code)
